summary: RBI's first hawkish rate hike in four years landed alongside a sharp Hormuz/Houthi-driven oil shock and a US Labor Department crackdown on IT-services green-card filings, while hard capex approvals (Green Energy Corridor-III, Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority), a 40-ship Cochin Shipyard export breakthrough, a ₹50,000cr Shyam Metalics steel MoU and a cancer-drug margin cap gave five sectors concrete, dated catalysts. Nuclear, CDMO, defence electronics, textiles, semis and gems & jewellery carried no fresh decided driver this week and should be read as fading on silence rather than reversed.

themes.name: Shipbuilding & marine
themes.thesis: Confirmed Western export orders and naval capacity milestones move the theme from port-capex sentiment to actual shipbuilding order flow.

drivers.what: Cochin Shipyard confirmed orders to build 40+ ships for buyers in the US, Germany, Norway and other nations
Cochin Shipyard cuts steel for 70T Bollard Pull tugs for Svitzer A/S, Denmark
drivers.source: headline: Cochin Shipyard cuts steel for 70 T Bollard Pull tugs for Svitzer A/S, Denmark

drivers.what: Defence Minister launches Fleet Support Ship-1 at Hindustan Shipyard Ltd, Vizag
drivers.source: policy event: Defence Minister launches Fleet Support Ship-1 at HSL in Vizag

beneficiaries.mechanism: Direct recipient of the 40-ship export order book and the Svitzer tug contract
Sentiment and order-pipeline tailwind as India's state shipbuilding capacity (alongside HSL) draws fresh foreign and naval orders
beneficiaries.evidence: policy event: Defence Minister launches Fleet Support Ship-1 at HSL in Vizag

beneficiaries.mechanism: Marine engineering/dredging services demand scales with shipyard throughput and port-adjacent activity

themes.name: Power transmission & grid capex
themes.thesis: A fully costed, Cabinet-approved transmission-plus-storage scheme converts the renewables evacuation bottleneck into orders for cable, tower, transformer and conductor makers.

drivers.what: Cabinet approved Green Energy Corridor-III: Rs 1,86,405cr outlay (Rs 1,36,378cr intra-state transmission + Rs 50,000cr for 50GWh battery storage) to evacuate 135GW renewable power by FY32-33

beneficiaries.mechanism: Direct cable/conductor demand from the intra-state transmission buildout
Transmission tower fabrication order book expands with new InSTS lines
Power transformer demand scales with new substation capacity under GEC-III
Conductor supply tied to new intra-state transmission corridors

themes.name: Renewables, solar & storage
themes.thesis: A government push to repower ~25GW of ageing wind capacity is a replacement-demand driver for turbine OEMs, distinct from and additive to new-capacity additions.

drivers.what: Renewable Energy Minister Pralhad Joshi said government is working on strategies to repower ~25GW of old wind projects, seeking industry input at Windergy India 2026

beneficiaries.mechanism: Leading wind OEM positioned to supply repowering turbines replacing decades-old installed base
Wind turbine manufacturer with direct exposure to replacement-cycle demand

themes.name: Data centres & digital infrastructure
themes.thesis: A quantified CBRE report confirms the capex cycle is real and compounding, with hyperscale/AI-linked demand now the majority of committed investment.

drivers.what: CBRE: India data centre sector attracted $173bn in investment commitments since 2021; capacity on track to reach 2GW by end-2026 (130MW added H1, 200MW+ expected H2); hyperscale/colo ~62% of commitments, 15%+ AI-linked

beneficiaries.mechanism: Server/AI-infrastructure maker scales directly with hyperscale and AI-linked data centre buildout
Precision cooling demand scales with new data centre capacity additions
Renewable EPC/power-supply partner to data centre campuses seeking captive clean power
beneficiaries.evidence: policy event: Waaree Renewable's data centre push raises the stakes

themes.name: US immigration crackdown on IT services
themes.thesis: The US Labor Department's suspension of PERM green-card filings for major Indian IT firms, layered on the pending $100k H-1B fee, raises the structural cost of the onsite-delivery model that mid-cap IT services peers also run, even though the named firms sit outside this universe.

drivers.what: US Labor Secretary Sonderling suspends PERM green-card processing for Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCL and Capgemini, citing displacement of American workers
Trump's proposed $100,000 H-1B fee hits a legal hurdle but remains a live cost overhang
drivers.source: headline: Trump's $100,000 H-1B fee hits legal hurdle

beneficiaries.mechanism: Meaningful US onsite/H-1B-dependent delivery model shares the same immigration cost and scrutiny exposure as the suspended large caps
US-heavy revenue mix with onsite staffing exposed to the same visa-cost pressure
BFSI-heavy US delivery model carries comparable H-1B/onsite cost exposure
Named alongside TCS in the same day's 'stocks to watch' coverage of the visa action, reflecting shared sector exposure
Engineering-services onsite delivery carries secondary exposure to tightening US work-visa policy
Onsite engineering-services delivery model carries secondary visa-policy exposure

themes.name: Crude oil supply shock & energy security
themes.thesis: Hormuz tanker attacks hit a new weekly record and Houthi missiles struck Saudi airports this week, pushing Brent above $104 — escalating last week's energysecurity read and widening the gap between upstream realizations and downstream marketing-margin pressure.

drivers.what: Record 10 tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz in the week to Oct 4 (prior high was 6); a crude tanker was struck again on Oct 6; Brent rose 4% to $104.28 on Oct 8 after Houthi missile strikes on Riyadh and Abha airports
India cuts back on costly Russian crude as West Asia flows recover; RBI intervenes to defend the rupee amid oil-driven outflows
drivers.source: headline: India cuts back on costly Russian crude as West Asia flows recover

beneficiaries.mechanism: Upstream E&P realizations rise directly with Brent
Domestic upstream producer benefits from higher crude realizations
Higher crude prices support E&P capex and drilling-rig dayrate demand
Refining/marketing margins compress when crude input costs spike faster than regulated retail pump prices
Refiner margin squeeze from crude cost spike
Refiner margin squeeze from crude cost spike

themes.name: Multimodal transport & logistics planning
themes.thesis: A new apex transport-planning authority tasked with a 10-year National Transport Master Plan and project appraisal above Rs 500cr should improve multimodal pipeline visibility and reduce logistics costs over time, a coordination tailwind rather than immediate capex.

drivers.what: Cabinet approved the Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority (ITLA), an SPV to prepare a 10-year National Transport Master Plan across roads, rail, ports, aviation, inland waterways and urban mobility, and to appraise projects of Rs 500c

beneficiaries.mechanism: Rail-linked container logistics gains from improved multimodal planning and reduced logistics-cost friction
Multimodal surface-logistics operator benefits from streamlined national transport planning
Port infrastructure operator benefits from coordinated long-horizon national logistics planning

themes.name: Steel capacity & demand cycle
themes.thesis: A large, dated greenfield capex commitment plus confirmed output/demand growth data extend last week's National Steel Policy thesis from a draft framework into company-level capital allocation.

drivers.what: Shyam Metalics signs Rs 50,000cr MoU with Maharashtra government for a 9 MTPA integrated steel complex at Chandrapur, in two phases (3.75MTPA + 5.25MTPA)
SAIL H1 hot metal output rose 2% YoY to 10.2 MT
drivers.source: headline: SAIL H1 hot metal output 10.2 MT, up 2% on year

drivers.what: Tata Steel CEO flags domestic steel demand growth of 8-10% in H2 and NINL capacity expansion to 5 MTPA
drivers.source: headline: Steel demand to grow 8-10% in H2: T V Narendran

beneficiaries.mechanism: Direct party to the Rs 50,000cr Maharashtra capacity-expansion MoU
Rising hot metal output and sector-wide H2 demand growth support realizations and volumes
beneficiaries.evidence: headline: SAIL H1 hot metal output 10.2 MT, up 2% on year

beneficiaries.mechanism: General beneficiary of the 8-10% H2 domestic steel demand growth guidance
beneficiaries.evidence: headline: Steel demand to grow 8-10% in H2: T V Narendran

themes.name: Anti-cancer drug margin cap
themes.thesis: A decided government price intervention caps trade margins on all non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, directly compressing realized pricing for domestic oncology-focused formulators even as it does not touch manufacturing cost structure.

drivers.what: Government caps trade margins at 30% of MRP for all non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs (110 drugs, including 35 patented), expected to cut MRPs by up to 70% and save patients Rs 2,500cr annually

beneficiaries.mechanism: Major oncology-generics revenue base sees realized pricing compressed by the new MRP-linked trade margin cap
Oncology biosimilar portfolio carries partial exposure to the new trade-margin ceiling
